two_insertions: pure closed-vocabulary/redaction helpers, C1266 structural log filter and best-effort synchronous private logger
one synchronous observation call after existing safe error parsing before existing throw

diagnostic.trigger: existing error branch only: HTTP400 / invalid_json_schema / text.format.schema / mission_unified_director plus C1266 structural wire markers
diagnostic.context_only: existing closed structural keys or validated internal $ref terminal; never enum/required/prose values
diagnostic.correlation: bounded provider_request_id and same Supabase invocation/execution ID and time as unchanged runtime work_id/measurement_id diagnostic; genuine persisted request/schema snapshot linked by that existing work identity

structural_filter.definitions: nonempty $defs keys c1266LiteralN with producer string/minLength1/maxLength300/enum-array shape; no enum literal copied
structural_filter.headers: director-proposal/4, role-interpretation/2, exact six role fields/required, singleton UUID master_session/source_window, source_window equals root, singleton SHA source_revision/roster_sha256, bound interpretations cardinality
structural_filter.scope: structural filter only, does not authenticate or grant Count; existing validateC1266ExecutionAttestation remains unchanged

risk_limits: Closed vocabulary and quote/fragment masking can hide an unknown causal term; no guarantee the next refusal becomes self-explanatory.
Request ID enables provider correlation only if the provider retains accessible error records; not verified.
Original error body remains capped4096 bytes. Oversized/unparseable bodies keep existing unknown behavior and may produce no new observation.
A syntax check is not semantic/privacy qualification or Staff proof. No application imports, fixtures, gameplay or provider calls were executed.
No absolute zero Generation promise: failed Count keeps0 Gen for that work; a positive Count can advance normally.
Synchronous bounded parsing and console output still have local execution overhead, not measured; no new asynchronous wait or hash is introduced.
Structural markers limit this log to C1266-shaped requests, not a single work; they do not prove authorization. Runtime attestation remains the authority.
Correlation depends on accessible existing runtime/invocation logs and genuinely persisted schema snapshot; no new schema hash or IDs are emitted.

authority_and_budget.decision_required_before_future_install_: Parent/user must settle explicit budget authority, including any exception, before this proposal becomes an integrated candidate or Staff observation. No ledger change or reset made.
